provenance_note: SCOPE (JC-007, extended by maintainer decision 2026-09-16): ITLOS decisions in proceedings concerning the Area are in scope, and for issue #9 that scope is EXTENDED to the judges' declarations published with those decisions; party pleadings remain out of scope. IDENTIFIER (JC-008): case-number based, and for orders decoded as Case <n>, Order No. <m> of <year>. THAT DECODING DOES NOT REACH THIS INSTRUMENT. The Order of 18 July 2026 states no order number anywhere in its 52 pages - the string 'Order 2026/' does not occur in its text, and the running header reads only 'List of Cases: No. 35' - and no register was consulted to infer one, because minting an identifier the instrument does not state would put an invented citation into an authoritative record. It is therefore identified by DATE: 'case35-order-18jul2026'. The order numbers in evidence across this corpus are 3, 4, 6, 8 and 9; 2026/5 and 2026/7 appear nowhere. This order is the COMPANION of itlos/order/case34-order-18jul2026, delivered the same day in the parallel case, and the two are cited together below. WHAT THIS ORDER DOES: unanimously prescribes provisional measures under article 290, paragraph 1, of the Convention pending the final decision - (a) the Authority shall act in accordance with the relevant legal framework, including rules of due process, in the procedure for the inquiry mandated by the Council under paragraphs 9 and 10 of the 2025 Council Decision; (b) the Authority shall in particular clarify or provide TOML the relevant information concerning that procedure and the questions posed to it, so as to enable TOML to respond while engaging constructively; (c) the Parties shall cooperate and refrain from any action that might lead to aggravating the dispute - and further decides that TOML and the Authority shall each submit the initial report referred to in paragraph 190 not later than 31 August 2026, authorising the President of the Chamber after that date to request such information as he considers appropriate, and that each Party shall bear its own costs. Chamber: President ATTARD; Judges JESUS, KULYK, KITTICHAISAREE, KOLODKIN, LIJNZAAD, DUAN, BROWN, CARACCIOLO, ARMAS PFIRTER, JOYINI; Registrar HINRICHS OYARCE. Judge Kittichaisaree and Judge Brown each append a declaration to the Order; Judge Brown's declaration in this case is a SEPARATE instrument from the one appended in Case No. 34 (see itlos/declaration/case35-brown-18jul2026). TEXT RECOVERY - NO OCR, DERIVED IN CI UNDER THE PIN: this is a BORN-DIGITAL document carrying the Tribunal's own text layer, unlike the sibling ITLOS orders 2026/6, 2026/8 and 2026/9, which are office-scanner images whose text was recovered by two-engine OCR. pdftotext returns the Tribunal's own characters, so there is nothing to reconcile and no engine disagreement to adjudicate. Because this corpus's pinned toolchain is Poppler 22.02.0 (CI runs ubuntu-22.04) while the workstation that authored this record runs 26.01.0, the text was NOT derived locally: the committed extractor is run in CI under the pin (issue #9, approach 1), so text_sha256 is a hash that CI itself re-derives. text_fidelity is extracted_verified on the strength of two checks. (i) Wording: every token of the derived text appears IN ORDER in the raw extraction - nothing was reworded, reordered or dropped in normalisation. (ii) Content: Tesseract 5.5.0 was run over independent 300-dpi renders of pages 1, 27 and 52; 100% of its word tokens are present in the derived text on pages 1 and 52 and 99.1% on page 27, where the two absent tokens are OCR noise (a hyphenation split and 'managing' for 'managing'). A page whose content were missing or garbled would show as bulk coverage loss. STRUCTURAL NORMALISATION, matched to the scan-based sibling records: masthead and page numbers removed; hard line wraps rejoined into paragraphs; the left-margin paragraph numbers folded back onto the paragraphs they number; display lines, the disposition, each signature line and the closing note kept as their own block; curly quotation marks and apostrophes normalised to straight; canonical UTF-8, LF, no BOM, one trailing newline. Two residual artefacts are recorded rather than hidden: a sentence continuing across a layout break whose continuation opens on a capitalised word remains a separate block, and a run of roman-numeral markers remains a block of its own. The typed signature names are retained; the handwritten strokes are not part of the text. original.pdf remains the integrity anchor and original_sha256 is the hash of the official file itself. COVERAGE GAP: the order closes 'Done in English and in French, both texts being equally authoritative', so French is an equally authentic text (cf. JC-004); no French version is published, and it would be ingested as itlos/order/case35-order-18jul2026-fr under JC-006.
